name: LootboxSpecialEntry - Default (seed v1)
description: A lootbox special (jackpot): a rare item that boxes can give instead of a normal roll. Saving it tags the item 'Lootbox Special', which takes it out of every normal pool.

steps.description: The jackpot item and which boxes can give it.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: Given exactly as designed, with its default enchantments and no rolled ones. Deleting the special later keeps the tag; remove it on the item to return the item to the pools.

fields.label: Box type
fields.description: Only boxes of this type can give it. Empty = boxes of every type.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disabled specials are skipped; the item stays out of the normal pools.

steps.description: Specials are checked before the normal roll, each with its own chance; the first hit wins.

fields.label: From box grade (stars)
fields.description: Only boxes with at least this many stars (1-10) can give it.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Specials are checked from low to high; with several hits the first one wins.
